title: Karbi language - its language family and related languages
description: Dharamsing Teron talks about how Karbi has influenced other languages and been influenced by them. He cites linguists who relate Karbi to the Kukish or Kuki-Chin languages (IPA /kuki t͡ʃin/) and to Naga, Meitei, Garo and Khasi. Assamese is the most recent influence, as the Karbi people came into closer contact with Assamese speakers during and after 1947. Subhashish Panigrahi interviewed him remotely, with his permission, on 21 May 2017. This is part 5 of the nine-part interview, and mjw010 is the full recording.
